title: Sítio Guaratinguetá - API
description: Visão inicial das requisições REST em /api/v1.

config.content:
## Sítio Guaratinguetá - API

Acompanhe as rotas REST, especialmente `/api/v1/estoque`. Pesquise por `request.id` quando o usuário informar um código de erro.

data_source.query: FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "http_request" AND url.path LIKE "/api/v1*" | STATS requests = COUNT()

FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "http_request" AND url.path LIKE "/api/v1*" | EVAL status = TO_INTEGER(http.response.status_code) | WHERE status >= 400 AND status < 500 | STATS api_4xx = COUNT()
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "http_request" AND url.path LIKE "/api/v1*" | EVAL status = TO_INTEGER(http.response.status_code) | WHERE status >= 500 | STATS api_5xx = COUNT()
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "http_request" AND url.path LIKE "/api/v1*" | EVAL latency_ms = TO_DOUBLE(event.duration) / 1000000 | STATS avg_latency_ms = AVG(latency_ms)
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "http_request" AND url.path LIKE "/api/v1*" | STATS requests = COUNT() BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action == "http_request" AND url.path LIKE "/api/v1*" | EVAL endpoint_status = CONCAT(url.path, " ", TO_STRING(http.response.status_code)) | STATS count = COUNT() BY endpoint_status | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 20
FROM logs-sitiopro.app-* | WHERE event.action IN ("api_business_error", "api_validation_error", "api_unexpected_error", "ACCESS_DENIED") | STATS count = COUNT() BY event.action | SORT count DESC
